anna_finance: FYI vendor emailed — eu-west GPU reserved hourly up ~18% starting 2026-04-01. This hits Dedicated unit econ if we pass through partial cost.
raj_infra: ugh. Is this only new reservations or retrospec bill changes? billing-bot: Notice: Upcoming price update: resource 'GPU:g5' region 'eu-west' effective 2026-04-01. No retro billing.
emily_platform: Thanks @anna. We need a quick margin check for Dedicated tiers + any contract protection clauses.
anna_finance: Quick sketch of options:
- A) Pass through 100% to customers (raise dedicated price) — protects margin but churn risk
- B) Absorb 50% for 3 months while we rebalance commitments — short term hit
- C) Rebalance reserved pools between regions + use burst credits to cover peak — ops risk
raj_infra: From infra side: we can reassign some eu-west reserved capacity from lower-util internal pools. Utilization report shows ~22% slack on staging clusters that could be swapped.
chad_sre: Also can shift non-latency workloads to us-west spot for 4–6 weeks. Network egress between regions is small for these jobs. Will need a plan to drain and rehydrate KV caches.
emily_platform: Need numbers. Anna — can you run a delta for committed GPU cost impact and estimated price hike pass-through per Dedicated seat?
anna_finance: On it. Quick back-of-envelope: current eu-west reserved cost = $0.92/hr -> new = $1.09/hr (+18%). For a 100-GPU pool that’s +$1,700/day. If we pass 100% to customers on Dedicated tier that's +8% on Dedicated per-month invoice. If we absorb 50% for a month it's ~$25k hit.
raj_infra: If we instead reallocate 30 GPUs from staging, and shift 20 GPUs to burstable in us-west, we offset ~45% of the delta. Ops effort ~2 FTE-days.
chad_sre: One caution: moving GPUs across regions will change latency SLAs for some enterprise customers. We need per-route policy exceptions in the console before any migration.
emily_platform: Also evaluate contract language — some Dedicated contracts have CPI/energy passthroughs. Legal may allow partial indexation. I'll ping legal.
anna_finance: I'll model three scenarios in the spreadsheet and share link. Minimal numbers now: Option A (pass-through): +8% Dedicated ARPU; Option B (absorb 50%): -$25k/mo hit; Option C (rebalance + spot): +2% op risk, ~+2% ARPU uplift if we reprice slightly.
raj_infra: Action items:
 - anna_finance: model scenario spreadsheet + recommend target price delta (due EOD)
 - emily_platform: check contracts & legal clauses (cc: legal)
 - chad_sre: run feasibility on region reassign (drain plan + cache warm-up estimate)
 - billing-bot: flag any customers with geo-locks that prevent region move
billing-bot: Triggered: Query run for customers with 'region_lock' = true returned 7 Dedicated contracts. See /ops/billing/locked-customers report.
anna_finance: Thanks. If we need to escalate to pricing WG I can prep a short deck. Would prefer avoid full pass-through unless churn risk seems low.
emily_platform: Agreed. Keep comms tight — if we change pricing we'll need 30d notice. Let's sync in 2 hours.
raj_infra: 👍
chad_sre: 👍 :wrench:
